articles.title: BEL, HAL, other defence stocks jump up to 5% after US raids Venezuela
articles.summary: Defence company shares surged on January 5, fueled by escalating geopolitical tensions between the US and Venezuela. This situation significantly boosted investor interest in defence-related counters, illustrating how international relations directly impact market sectors. Aspirants should observe how global political events create economic ripples, particularly in strategic areas like defence, affecting stock performance and investment trends.
